supersedes_reason: v1 omits policy.push_to_hub; on the official AMD Radeon Cloud run LeRobot 0.4.4 TrainPipelineConfig.validate raised 'policy.repo_id missing' before data loading because policy.push_to_hub resolved truthy without a repo_id. v2 pins policy.push_to_hub=false and the ACT ROCm preflight now fail-closes unless policy.push_to_hub is exactly false.
policy_device_semantics: ROCm-enabled PyTorch exposes AMD HIP devices through the torch.cuda API.
claim_boundary: This contract and a passing preflight authorize a single-GPU Radeon Cloud ACT baseline run only. They do not establish convergence, closed-loop task success, robustness, or an AMD performance advantage.
